items.title: Higher-dimensional black holes hide an exact symmetry in their ringing, and string-inspired gravity breaks it
items.summary: Strike a bell, and it rings with a pitch and a fading that tell you about the bell: its size, its shape, the metal it is made of. Black holes ring too.
